# react-native-roster

> A React Native read surface for layered intervals with provenance across lanes
> and a shared time axis. API unreleased. Pure core types, geometry, coverage,
> caches, axis helpers, Roster, useRoster, Schedule, useSchedule, and the recurrence
> adapter are implemented, along with the timezone and provenance routes and ten
> schedule gallery routes.

## Vocabulary

| Term | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| roster | The whole read surface: a shared time axis, lanes, and layers. |
| lane | One person or resource row containing layers, a label, and optional metadata. |
| layer | A named, ordered set of intervals and gaps with a role, z-order, and style. |
| interval | Covered absolute time, `[start, end)` in epoch milliseconds, with sources. |
| gap | Removed absolute time with sources; survives complete subtraction. |
| source | Provenance identified by `(kind, id)`; its label is display metadata. |
| window | A bare absolute `{ start, end }` span; resolution belongs to the axis. |
| projection | Geometry mapping: horizontal for a roster, columns for a schedule. |
| adapter | A function outside the core that converts upstream data into lanes and layers. |
| schedule | One lane projected into days across and wall-clock hours down. |

## Contract

The authoritative contract is issue #3. A lane contains layers; a layer contains
covered intervals and removed gaps. Both carry `sources: Source[]`. Absolute time
is epoch milliseconds and end-exclusive. Source identity is `(kind, id)`; labels
never participate in equality. A window is only `{ start, end }`.

`LayerRole` values are `availability`, `booking`, and `custom`. A projection is
horizontal (roster) or columns (schedule). Layout works only on visible lanes;
coverage works on every lane. Target-warm means the exact requested cache keys
already exist; target-cold means they do not. Rule, lane, and view timezones have
separate jobs. The core uses standard JavaScript and `Intl`; recurrence expansion
and Temporal belong exclusively to the rrule adapter.

## Entry points

- `react-native-roster`: Roster, useRoster, Schedule, useSchedule, default zone fillers, rendering types, and core re-exports.
- `react-native-roster/core`: pure types, geometry, coverage, axis helpers, and counters.
- `react-native-roster/rrule`: recurrence expansion, caps, provenance, and caches.
- `react-native-roster/package.json`: package metadata.

Metro resolves the `react-native` condition to TypeScript source. Other runtimes
resolve the default condition to emitted CommonJS. Type declarations live in dist.
No `.js` extensions on relative imports in src. No consumer-specific entities.

## Core usage constraints

- `layoutLane(lane, window, projection)` is for visible lanes; `coverageFor(lane, window)` is for every lane.
- `flagFor` honors explicit flags, infers only `empty-in-window`, and never infers `never-set` or completeness.
- Geometry preserves exact bounds and source sets, applies inset, and splits at column and transition scale boundaries.
- Columns use local `x` coordinates and `rect.column`; repeated time has two half-height sub-regions.
- `timeAtY` returns an epoch time or null. Horizontally, `timeAtX(projection, window, x)` returns an epoch time at true elapsed length; the window supplies the origin the projection lacks.
- `snapToStep` floors in the view zone and clamps at transitions; the step must be a positive divisor of 60.
- `WindowSpec` supports day, week, month, and custom spans. Use windowFor, prev, next, and today; week starts Monday by default.
- Month navigation clamps short-month anchors. Day columns have full local-day bounds, English weekday labels, localDate, and transitions. Skipped dates have no column.
- Cache keys use lane id, version or a canonical structural layers encoding, window, and all projection fields. Coverage excludes projection. Lane display metadata and completeness never enter keys.
- Bump version when layers change. Treat returned references as read-only. Flags and coverage are assembled fresh while rects are reused.
- layoutStats and coverageStats count runs and cacheHits; resetStats clears counters only. clearLayoutCache and clearCoverageCache clear keys only.
- The deterministic workload fixture emits 70 rects plus gap rects per lane per week: 63 rects and 7 gap rects. Workload W has 200 lanes, two layers, 24 visible lanes, and 15-minute ticks.
- Intl formatToParts supplies zone offsets. Hourly transition probes are refined to millisecond boundaries. No Temporal, recurrence, or React imports in core.

## Roster usage constraints

- Give Roster a bounded viewport. The hook owns coverage for every lane; geometryFor calls the content-cached layout only when mounted lanes request it. Wire onLayout in custom layouts.
- Ticks derive wall steps arithmetically across day transitions and cache by window bounds, timezone, span, minuteStep, and pxPerMinute. Identical tick inputs return the same array without Intl calls.
- The default label column is 180 px, rows are 48 px, and horizontal scale is at least 0.5 px per elapsed minute. rowHeight and pxPerMinute are configurable.
- Body scroll drives Reanimated shared x and y values. Vertical scrolling never updates React state. All lane labels share one translated column. LegendList extraData keys window, projection, highlight identity, and rect zone fillers. Reanimated is an optional peer for core-only installs, required for rendering.
- All eight zone props are render functions: emptyZone, laneLabelZone, headerCellZone, intervalZone, gapZone, headerZone, laneLabelColumnZone, and bodyZone. Default fillers are exported from the root.
- intervalZone supplies a View positioned by rect bounds and z; gapZone fills an already positioned pressable. Default gap content is null.
- onIntervalHover(rect, lane) reports the winning interval as a web pointer moves; native attaches no hover handler. Both variants share interval-hover.types.ts and a browser remap.
- press chooses intervals, then gaps, then snapped empty space; highest z and later-layer ties win. Only one callback fires. highlightSource compares kind and id.
- Highlighting and sorting retain geometry. Warm target viewport keys yield zero expanded, layout runs, and coverage runs; newly visible lanes with absent geometry keys require layout.
- byLabel is the default comparator. byCoverage accepts measure availability or availabilityMinusBooking, sorts descending, and breaks ties by label.
- complete is lane.complete ?? true. An incomplete lane also shows its notice in the first empty row span. incompleteLabel defaults to Availability may be incomplete; neverSetLabel defaults to No availability set.
- Gallery routes cover presses, gaps, equal-z precedence, highlighting across 20 lanes, coverage sorting across 200 lanes, flags, and incomplete expansion. Highlight and incomplete routes call the rrule adapter. The gallery routes use named test fixtures and offer span, step, view timezone, and sort controls, plus a sources readout. Expo SDK 54 experiments.reactCompiler is enabled. window.__roster exposes live layoutStats, coverageStats, resetStats, clearLayoutCache, clearCoverageCache, expandStats, resetExpandStats, and clearExpandCache functions with stable bridge identity. Only on-screen counters sample every 500 ms. Fixture records own zones and showsEmptyExample. The dst-week and mixed-timezones routes expand adapter rules for the selected window and offer March and November weeks; the counter display includes expanded.
- iOS and Android scrolling and React DevTools LaneRow render counts still need the device pass.

- WindowSpec.timezone is the only component view-zone input; Lane.timezone is an IANA display badge only. Rule and date zones belong exclusively to the adapter. Chicago DST weeks have 167 or 169 hourly boundaries, including midnight day ticks; 09:00 aligns with its header label horizontally and has the same y in columns. London 09:00 appears at Chicago 03:00 or 04:00 by date.
- With current keys target-warm, Chicago to Auckland reuses retained expansion, computes visible layouts once, and computes all lane coverage once. Lane-zone edits retain geometry references and compute nothing. Rule-zone edits compute only the changed rule and lane when their target keys are absent and intervals change. Coverage excludes projection, so equal absolute windows reuse it across view zones.

## Schedule usage constraints

- This feature is about a schedule; its children are days. Schedule takes one lane and a day/week WindowSpec only; month and custom are rejected by ScheduleWindowSpec.
- useSchedule returns exactly window, days, projection, geometry, now, press, and ready status. Its standalone grid is 280 px wide; Schedule supplies measured width internally after measurement. pxPerHour defaults to 48 and must be a positive finite number; the gutter is 48 px wide.
- Body scrolling is vertical only. Each day has 24 equal wall-clock bands; interval insets are already applied in final rect bounds. Day headers and the left gutter stay aligned.
- gutterZone, dayHeaderZone, skippedDateZone, columnZone, transitionZone, nowLineZone, intervalZone, gapZone, and incompleteZone are documented optional render functions. Default fillers are exported. Interval and gap fillers, platform press-point resolution, and styles are shared with Roster.
- press(columnIndex, x, y) resolves timeAtY then snapToStep, then the shared interval/gap walk at the original point within that column. Skipped time fires nothing; repeated halves resolve distinct absolute times, including Lord Howe's 30-minute repeat.
- Missing local dates have header markers but no column. The Apia week containing 2011-12-30 has six columns. Repeats have an again divider; skips are hatched.
- now is inside the window or null and refreshes every minute. incompleteLabel defaults to Availability may be incomplete; incompleteZone draws it in reserved empty space above the grid when lane.complete is false.
- Ten schedule-* gallery routes have span, step, view-zone, and projection controls. The side-by-side route renders the same lane in Roster and Schedule. These fixtures use the recurrence adapter and the shared counter bridge with live expandStats, resetExpandStats, and clearExpandCache.
- The hook harness proves exact session and exclusion sources, midnight continuity, skipped/repeated presses, and projection switching with expanded delta 0, columns layout delta 1, and returning horizontal layout delta 0.

## Adapter usage constraints

- Import expandRuleSet, envelopeFor, expandStats, resetExpandStats, and clearExpandCache only from react-native-roster/rrule.
- RosterRule, RosterDate, RuleSet, ExpandOptions, ExpandResult, and ExpandStats live on that subpath; Weekday, Interval, Gap, Source, and Window come from core.
- Local hours use the rule's IANA zone; the view zone is never an input. Hours are paired, end-exclusive, and between 0 and 24. Dates with no hours cover the whole day.
- Plain dates and datetimes use the rule zone; offset datetimes represent instants. Date-only until includes the whole local day. Compatible disambiguation chooses the earlier repeat and advances skips.
- One absolute envelope pads the window by 48 hours on each side. All includes, excludes, and dates share it, including spans that cross its bounds. Assembly clips to the display window.
- Interval sources are includes only; gap sources are excludes only. Full subtraction retains a gap. A date note becomes Source.label.
- Per-rule content keys exclude id and note, and include envelope bounds and the per-rule cap. Sources are assembled fresh. Only occurrence lists are cached.
- maxEntries defaults to 2000; maxEnvelopes defaults to 4 per set. Both are LRUs. Histories are keyed by canonical set content; clear discarded sets explicitly with clearExpandCache.
- caps.perRuleOccurrences defaults to 400; totalOccurrences defaults to 10000. Caps and cache limits accept nonnegative integers, including zero.
- Total admission runs fresh in rule id order, then date id order. Drop the first list that cannot fit and all later lists whole. Fully enumerated drops have exact counts; per-rule truncation reports droppedAtLeast 1.
- Caps count envelope occurrences. Propagate result.complete to Lane.complete; capped output is not definitive.
- expandStats returns cumulative counters; result.stats describes the call. resetExpandStats clears counters only; clearExpandCache clears occurrence entries and envelope histories only.
- Containment reuses bounds; retained occurrence entries yield expanded 0. Total-cap changes never invalidate per-rule lists; per-rule-cap changes do. LRU eviction can require re-expansion within retained bounds.
- rrule-temporal 1.5.2 and @js-temporal/polyfill 0.5.1 are pinned runtime dependencies reachable only from src/rrule. Root/core emitted import graphs are tested for isolation.
